instruction: Enable Filter Keys and keep it enabled.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$src='using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public class FK { [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct FILTERKEYS { public uint cbSize; public uint dwFlags; public uint iWaitMSec; public uint iDelayMSec; public uint iRepeatMSec; public uint iBounceMSec; } [DllImport(\"user32.dll\", SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(uint uiAction, uint uiParam, ref FILTERKEYS pvParam, uint fWinIni); }'; Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src; $fk=New-Object FK+FILTERKEYS; $fk.cbSize=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SizeOf($fk); $ok=[FK]::SystemParametersInfo(0x0032,$fk.cbSize,[ref]$fk,0); if ($ok -and (($fk.dwFlags -band 0x1) -ne 0)) { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
